svg.title: Women's Class A service dress coat: Honor Guard white parade gloves (worn, at the cuffs) (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-a-coat-female)

g.title: White parade gloves worn, one at each cuff (CAPR 39-1 9.6.7.7: worn with the top of the glove just above the wrist): drawn over the sheet and the pistol belt or sling; the mask takes back what the sleeve and the body hide, as the guidance figure shows

Gloved right hand (the wearer's right; the viewer's left): a white parade glove below the cuff, the hand at rest, back of the hand outward, thumb toward the body, fingers curled as the guidance figure draws it (CAPR 39-1 9.6.7.7). One drawing, mirrored for the other hand

Gloved left hand (the wearer's left; the viewer's right): a white parade glove below the cuff, the hand at rest, back of the hand outward, thumb toward the body, fingers curled as the guidance figure draws it (CAPR 39-1 9.6.7.7). One drawing, mirrored for the other hand
